account: Today I read my appointments and took my scheduled market walk. The secretary reported no correspondence or unusual concerns, and two townsfolk said they had no news. However, my neighbour says the builder is coordinating supplies and lighting for the hall, and that Townsfolk Two mentioned lights going up at the bakery. I have not confirmed the bakery report or learned the purpose of either arrangement. The builder is now nearby carrying a lantern, which fits lighting work but does not establish an occasion. These preparations may be for a celebration, perhaps involving both the hall and bakery, but that is only a possibility; I have no evidence of a particular celebration or of deliberate concealment. My neighbour asked whether I had heard of a celebration, suggesting they do not know the occasion either. I would like to ask the builder directly. Separately, my neighbour has confirmed our three o'clock tea at the cottage at (16, -60, 105), just east of the ferry landing. I still need to keep lunch at home at noon and accounts in the office at one.
